title: Salt Berry Bomb Nicotine Salt E-Liquid
description: Berry Bomb takes luscious ripe, red berry as its base note, then deftly folds in flavours of aniseed, liquorice and menthol for a sublime vape that fires up all the senses. Sweet and punchy on the inhale with a delightfully cool kick on the exhale. This premium e-liquid’s 50VG/50PG blend offers the perfect balance between flavour and cloud production and the nicotine salt solution makes it ideal for use in classic e-cigarette starter vape kits and pod vape devices. Perfect for recent ex-smokers or vapers seeking the immediate, satisfying nicotine relief provided by nic salts with a super-smooth throat hit.
